name: operations.transfers

list.description: Read full native transfer orders within the verified inquiry scope.

parameters.name: from-date
parameters.description: Native Transaction Date start day YYYY-MM-DD; both ordered bounds are required.

parameters.name: to-date
parameters.description: Native Transaction Date end day YYYY-MM-DD, at or after from-date.

purpose: Inspect native transfer orders through bounded inquiry-only requests.

fields.name: orderNo
fields.meaning: Native transfer order identity; orderId and reportId are separate references.

fields.name: debitAmount
fields.meaning: Native decimal text or null/blank, preserved without conversion.

fields.name: creditAmount
fields.meaning: Native decimal text or null/blank; distinct from debit amount.

fields.name: orderStatus
fields.meaning: Native order state, separate from receiptStatus and executeResult.

identity_description: Native orderNo identifies one returned record within the tenant and exact acquisition scope.
limitations: Fixed GUAPW3SG tenant. POST form /transferOrderQuery.json contains a serialized transferOrderQueryRequestVO with fixed empty debitEntity/creditEntity arrays and blank debit/credit date bounds.
Required ISO Transaction Date bounds expand to native 00:00:00 and 23:59:59. Native source timezone and the relationship to displayed gmtCreate remain unproven; no local date-membership filtering.
Absolute rowStart offsets use pageSize=10. Top-level count must equal result.count; records are result.data. Other native filters are unsupported.

Preserve full native rows, nested logs, unknown fields and nullable monetary strings. orderStatus, receiptStatus and executeResult remain separate raw states; no bank-success inference or detail enrichment.

The host SDK owns retries, completeness and publication. Duplicate/conflicting identities and count gaps remain incomplete; strict refresh preserves the prior capture on rejection. Widths are historical successful request sizes, not measured backend maxima.
